digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test routing
propositions: Nineteen audited static repository-policy test nodes are OS/Python-invariant and redundantly executed in all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13).

Repository-policy nodes must be marked with a strict repo_policy pytest marker and collected only in the Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process, with `and not repo_policy` appended to the other three default selections.

The exact 19 inventoried function-level nodes from seven mixed test modules must carry the repo_policy marker while all unmarked behavioral/runtime/subprocess tests retain their original cross-platform selection.
The shared workflow default selector must route repo_policy only to Ubuntu 3.13 and exclude it from Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 and macOS 3.13 without adding new jobs, runners, or pytest sessions.
Test ci_workflow_parity must validate that the marked inventory partitions cleanly from non-marked cases and that the four-cell integration/default matrix is unchanged.
